name: Celestial Blade
description: An extraordinarily rare masterwork said to represent the pinnacle of swordsmithing. Only the wealthiest collectors can afford one.
prompt: A masterwork minimalist 2D flat vector game icon. Pure solid pitch-black silhouette of a soaring cosmic celestial katana blade floating vertically with a ring of orbiting star fragments and solar ribbons. Centered completely inside a giant solid flat bright crimson red circular solar eclipse ring (#FF2035). Pure solid pitch-black background (#000000). Razor-sharp vector edges, duotone black and crimson, no 3D rendering, no text, no watermark.
